environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB with mutual TLS enforcement. ALB listener configured with MutualAuthentication mode 'verify' using a private CA trust store (ACM PCA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-def-123). The trust store contains only leaf certificates issued to three specific internal services (notification-svc, dashboard-bff, scheduler-svc) with CN-based identity. Connection attempts without a valid client certificate signed by the private CA receive TLS handshake failure at the ALB layer before any HTTP data reaches the target group. Additionally, the ALB access logs show the client cert DN is propagated via X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Subject header for audit. The ECS task's security group only allows inbound from the ALB's security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f), not from the VPC CIDR directly, preventing ALB bypass.
